segments.sn42.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn42.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena rājantepure rājaparisāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi –
segments.sn42.10:1.3: “kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, paṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajatan”ti!
segments.sn42.10:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
segments.sn42.10:2.2: Atha kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.10:2.4: Na kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nappaṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā”ti.
segments.sn42.10:2.5: Asakkhi kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
segments.sn42.10:2.6: Atha kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.10:2.7: “idha, bhante, rājantepure rājaparisāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi –
segments.sn42.10:2.8: ‘kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, paṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajatan’ti.
segments.sn42.10:2.9: Evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, bhante, taṃ parisaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.sn42.10:2.11: Na kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nappaṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā’ti.
segments.sn42.10:2.12: Asakkhiṃ khvāhaṃ, bhante, taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
segments.sn42.10:2.13: Kaccāhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva bhagavato homi, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaromi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī”ti?
segments.sn42.10:3.1: “Taggha tvaṃ, gāmaṇi, evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva me hosi, na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhasi, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākarosi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
segments.sn42.10:3.2: Na hi, gāmaṇi, kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nappaṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā.
segments.sn42.10:3.3: Yassa kho, gāmaṇi, jātarūparajataṃ kappati, pañcapi tassa kāmaguṇā kappanti.
segments.sn42.10:3.4: Yassa pañca kāmaguṇā kappanti ()[(tassapi jātarūparajataṃ kappati,)(syā. kaṃ.)], ekaṃsenetaṃ, gāmaṇi, dhāreyyāsi assamaṇadhammo asakyaputtiyadhammoti.
segments.sn42.10:3.6: tiṇaṃ tiṇatthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, dāru dārutthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, sakaṭaṃ sakaṭatthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, puriso purisatthikena pariyesitabbo [pariyesitabbo”ti (?)].
segments.sn42.10:3.7: Natvevāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, kenaci pariyāyena ‘jātarūparajataṃ sāditabbaṃ pariyesitabban’ti vadāmī”ti.

lines: Dasame taṃ parisaṃ etadavocāti tassa kira evaṃ ahosi “kulaputtā pabbajantā puttadārañceva jātarūparajatañca pahāyeva pabbajanti, na ca sakkā yaṃ pahāya pabbajitā, taṃ tehi gahetun”ti nayaggāhe ṭhatvā “mā ayyo”tiādivacanaṃ avoca.
Ekaṃsenetanti etaṃ pañcakāmaguṇakappanaṃ assamaṇadhammo asakyaputtiyadhammoti ekaṃsena dhāreyyāsi.
Pariyesitabbanti tiṇacchadane vā iṭṭhakacchadane vā gehe palujjante yehi taṃ kāritaṃ, tesaṃ santikaṃ gantvā “tumhehi kāritasenāsanaṃ ovassati, na sakkā tattha vasitun”ti ācikkhitabbaṃ.
Manussā sakkontā karissanti, asakkontā “tumhe vaḍḍhakiṃ gahetvā kārāpetha, mayaṃ te saññāpessāmā”ti vakkhanti.
Sace āvāsasāmikā natthi, aññesampi bhikkhācāravattena ārocetvā kāretuṃ vaṭṭati.
Na kevalañca sakaṭameva, aññampi vāsipharasukuddālādiupakaraṇaṃ evaṃ pariyesituṃ vaṭṭati.
Yaṃkiñci hi purisaṃ “hatthakammaṃ, āvuso, katvā dassasī”ti vatvā “dassāmi, bhante,”ti vutte “idañcidañca karohī”ti yaṃ icchati, taṃ kāretuṃ vaṭṭati.
Na tvevāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, kenaci pariyāyenāti jātarūparajataṃ panāhaṃ kenacipi kāraṇena pariyesitabbanti na vadāmi.
Nayaggāheti kutocipi asutvā kevalaṃ attano eva matiyā nayaggahaṇe ṭhatvā.

after.title: Maṇicūḷakasuttavaṇṇanā
lines: Kāretuṃ vaṭṭati sati sambhave paṭisaṅkhārassa, senāsanavināso na ajjhupekkhitabboti adhippāyo.
Attano ettha kiccāvasāne yaṃ gihīnaṃyeva santakaṃ tāvakālikaṃ, taṃ gihivikatanti āha “gihivikataṃ katvā”ti.
